findings.title: Job `client` field has two serialized shapes (ObjectId string on create/update vs populated {id,name} on list/detail); frontend keys off the populated shape
findings.location: design.md jobController.createJob/updateJob (no populate) vs getJob/listJobs (populate('client','name')); frontend JobDetailPage uses job.client.id
findings.fix: Re-populate client before responding on create and update (await job.populate('client','name')), and document in the API contract that job.client is ALWAYS the { id, name } object on every job-returning endpoint. Align the frontend to that single shape.

findings.title: Ownership check job.client.toString() is correct only while the ref is unpopulated; a later populate would silently break it
findings.fix: Specify a populate-independent comparison, e.g. String(job.client._id || job.client) !== req.user.id, OR state as an explicit invariant that ownership-checking controllers must fetch WITHOUT populate. Document the rule once.

findings.title: server/.env is gitignored and in-code mongoUri default stays ''; a fresh checkout silently runs in-memory instead of MongoDB
findings.location: design.md Env contract; config/env.js (mongoUri default ''); config/db.js (empty MONGO_URI -> warn + null)
findings.fix: Either set the in-code default to 'mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/talentbridge' so a bare checkout connects with no .env, or add an explicit 'copy .env.example to .env before dev/seed' setup step and state the in-memory path is only a safety net. State the choice.

findings.title: Clarify that createToken uses the Mongoose .id virtual, not a serialized toJSON result
findings.fix: Add a one-line note: user.id is the Mongoose .id virtual (always present on a saved doc); do not call createToken on a .toJSON() result.

findings.title: Frontend base URL hardcoded to localhost:4000 while CORS also allows 127.0.0.1:5173 origin
findings.location: design.md frontend client.js base URL; app.js CORS allow-list
findings.fix: Document that the app should be opened at http://localhost:5173 to match the hardcoded backend localhost:4000, or comment the base-URL constant to note the host-form expectation shared with CORS.
